run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T19:10:36Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by the otel-demo/product-catalog Deployment being unable to run any backend. The Deployment's product-catalog container has command ["invalid-command"] while the image is unchanged (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog), so the pod created in the new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf dies at container init with StartError "exec: \"invalid-command\": executable file not found in $PATH" (exit code 128), sits in CrashLoopBackOff with 5 restarts, and the Deployment reports 0 ready/0 available replicas (Available=False, MinimumReplicasUnavailable) since 19:09:02. The product-catalog Service endpoint lists the pod only under notReadyAddresses, and product-catalog's span rate fell from ~25/s to 0 at ~19:09, i.e. it stopped serving. Frontend's own span-error ratio, which was 0% from 18:51:36 through 19:09:36, began rising at 19:10:36 (the alert start) and reached ~57.6% at 19:20; its error spans are grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 3.56/s, GET /api/products/{productId} 3.56/s, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 0.71/s, GET /api/recommendations 0.71/s, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.45/s, POST /api/checkout 0.45/s and GET (server) 4.27/s. Checkout and recommendation show their own error spans on ProductCatalogService calls, and frontend-proxy records its own ingress/egress error spans, so the frontend alert is a symptom of the product-catalog outage rather than a frontend pod fault (that pod is Running/Ready with 0 restarts).

claims.text: frontend's own span error ratio (STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans / all spans, 5m rate) was 0% from 18:51:36 to 19:09:36, then 4.15% at 19:10:36, 34.8% at 19:12:36 and 56.6-57.6% from 19:14 onward (57.63% at 19:20:00).

frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans (5m rate at 19:20:00) are: GET (server) 4.265/s, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 3.559/s, GET /api/products/{productId} 3.559/s, executing api route (pages) /api/products/[productId] 3.559/s, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 0.707/s, GET /api/recommendations 0.707/s, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.447/s, POST /api/checkout 0.447/s, POST (server) 0.447/s, tcp.connect 0.0085/s; all other frontend operations carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET only.

The otel-demo/product-catalog Deployment specifies containers[0].command ["invalid-command"] with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, and its status at query time is replicas=1, ready=null, available=null, unavailable=1, with condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 19:09:02.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (created 19:09:02, owned by ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf) is Running but not Ready: container product-catalog is waiting with reason CrashLoopBackOff ("back-off 2m40s restarting failed container"), restartCount 5, and lastState terminated with exitCode 128, reason StartError, message "failed to create containerd task: ... exec: \"invalid-command\": executable file not found in $PATH".

The product-catalog ownership chain shows a config-only rollout: the Deployment owns ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 18:38:44, now replicas 0) and product-catalog-fcf7564cf (created 19:08:45, replicas 1), both with the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog.

Kubernetes events show the rollout and repeated start failures: Deployment product-catalog scaled up ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf at 19:08:45 and scaled down ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc 1->0 at 19:08:54 (old pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm stopped/deleted at 19:08:54); pods product-catalog-fcf7564cf-2fvnx (19:08:50) and product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (last at 19:12:15, count 6) both got Warning reason Failed with "exec: \"invalid-command\": executable file not found in $PATH", plus BackOff events (count 25 on vjj7l).

The otel-demo/product-catalog Service (selector opentelemetry.io/name=product-catalog, port 8080) has an endpoint subset containing only notReadyAddresses for pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (ip 100.96.2.148); no ready address is listed.

product-catalog's own span rate (sum of traces_span_metrics_calls_total, 1m rate) was ~22-26/s through 19:09:00 (25.8/s), dropped to 3.07/s at 19:10:00 and was 0/s at every point from 19:12:00 to 19:18:00; its only remaining status series is STATUS_CODE_UNSET at rate 0, i.e. it is emitting no spans.

product-catalog is the only otel-demo Deployment without ready replicas: all other 20 Deployments report desired=1, ready=1, available=1, while product-catalog reports ready=<none>, available=<none>, unavailable=1.

checkout shows its own error spans on oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (0.451/s) and its own server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (0.451/s), for a service error ratio of 50% at 19:20:00.
recommendation shows its own error spans on /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts (0.732/s) and internal span get_product_list (0.732/s), for a service error ratio of 66.67% at 19:20:00.
frontend-proxy has its own error spans on ingress (4.815/s) and router frontend egress (4.802/s) and an error ratio of 56.56% at 19:20:00, consistent with it observing failing frontend responses.

The frontend error-rate alert is caused by product-catalog having no runnable backend: the Deployment's command override ["invalid-command"] makes every start attempt fail, so the Service has no ready endpoint and callers' ProductCatalogService calls fail, which surfaces as frontend error spans on exactly the operations that call product-catalog (GetProduct directly, ListRecommendations and PlaceOrder indirectly).
cart is not the source: its only status series is STATUS_CODE_UNSET at 10.515/s with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, so its 10.5/s non-OK figure is unset-status spans, not errors.
ad is not a material source: its only ERROR series is 0.00426/s on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream, giving a 0.28% service error ratio at 19:20:00.

Frontend's own pod is not crashing or restarting: pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running, Ready=true, restartCount 0, started 18:38:45, so the errors originate from its calls to dependencies rather than container restarts.

The 19:08:45-19:09:02 rollout affecting product-catalog was not an image change: both the old ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc and the new product-catalog-fcf7564cf reference the identical image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, pointing to a configuration-only change (the container command).

Restore the product-catalog container command to the image's default entrypoint (remove the command override "invalid-command") — e.g. roll back Deployment product-catalog to the previous revision — then confirm the new pod reaches Ready, that the product-catalog Service endpoint gains a ready address, and that product-catalog span rate and the frontend error ratio return to their pre-19:09 baseline.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what set the product-catalog container command to "invalid-command" and the exact change time cannot be established.

Jaeger has no trace data covering the incident: a frontend trace search over 18:10:36-19:20:08 returned spans only up to source_end_at 18:54:03, and searches for frontend over 19:10:00-19:20:08 and 19:12:00-19:15:00 returned no_data, so span-level error details (e.g. gRPC status messages) for the failure window are unknown.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 returned zero lines both with and without a filter, so the frontend's application error text could not be read.
The product-catalog container never started (lastState StartError), and fetch_pod_logs reported no previous instance, so there are no product-catalog container logs.

Prometheus has no alerting rules loaded (list_prometheus_rules for RequestErrorRate and for type=alert both returned no_data), and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count and rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count have no series in this window, so the alert's exact expression and its reported value of 16.8667 could not be reproduced; the traces-based frontend error ratio measured here was 57.63% at 19:20:00.
The ~1.5 minute interval between the old product-catalog pod being deleted (19:08:54) and the first detectable rise in frontend errors (~19:10:36) is not explained by the collected evidence.
Whether end-user/customer requests failed outside the cluster is unverified; only in-cluster error spans on frontend-proxy and frontend were observed.
next_steps: Retrieve the deployment change audit (change_history) for otel-demo/product-catalog around 19:08:45Z to identify the actor that introduced command ["invalid-command"].
Have a human roll back or patch the product-catalog Deployment to remove the invalid command override and confirm rollout health (pod Ready, endpoint ready address present).
Re-check frontend span error ratio and product-catalog span rate after the fix to confirm the alert clears.
